svg.title: Sampling changes a correspondence-based distance
svg.desc: Both samplings evaluate the same analytic contour with the same starting point and direction. Direct equal-index matching remains mismatched under refinement. Uniform polygonal arclength resampling to 128 points reduces the error as the input polygons improve. The residual is not exactly zero at finite resolution.
